integrity: Two standalone standard-library programs independently enumerate the state set and switches; an explicit small graph-isomorphism certificate is included.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification of GP(10,3) three-edge-colourings modulo global colour names; no extension to other graphs. Originality qualified against computational datasets that may encode but do not explicitly state the adjacency.
title: The Desargues graph inside its own edge-Kempe switching graph
